query: I want to close out a lending account: repay all the debt and withdraw all the collateral. How do I size the amounts so nothing is left behind?
expected_behavior: Passes 0 as the withdraw amount for a full withdrawal (zero means full balance and overrides positive amounts for the same market) instead of computing an exact amount from a floor-rounded balance

If sizing manually, requests at least the half-up displayed supply balance so all supply shares burn, and states the payout is the floor-valued balance (a floor-sized request is a partial withdrawal with a ceiled share burn that leaves dust shares)
Sizes full repayment as at least the ceiled debt balance (ceil at both the shares->RAY and RAY->token steps) so all debt shares burn, and states the excess is refunded
Distinguishes the four share-rounding directions (supply mint floor, partial withdrawal burn ceil, debt mint ceil, partial repayment burn floor) and that a zero-share result reverts
States that withdraw with remaining debt must pass the LTV, HF >= 1e18 and minimum borrow collateral gates, so repay before withdraw
machine_checkable: For borrowScaledRay=1000000000000000000000000000 (1e27), borrowIndexRay=1000000000000000000000000001 (1e27+1) and decimals=7 the full-close amount is 10000001 base units (ceil), not 10000000
